description: A C# game engine in which a program opens a window, draws each frame with plain static calls named as raylib's functions are, and draws Dear ImGui in the same frame, over SDL3, Vulkan and Slang, with an ECS and source-generated behaviors underneath.
releaseNotes:
A test run whose every test has a result and none failed passes where a process was lost to its time limit alone, the loss said in a notice, so a Windows suite with nothing failing lets the pack run.
A probe is taken to see a surface within an eighth of the probes' spacing past where its rays reached, so a probe beyond a thin wall lends the screen's probes' hits beside it none of the light of the lamp outside, with a test at the thin wall's foot.
The leak tests read how far the process's memory grew from the most of its readings at the tenth, twentieth and thirtieth app, so a trough at one of them fails no flat series, and the instance one of them holds is in a file of its own.
The merge reads each probe above toward the point of this probe's ray nearest where its own ray met a surface, by the reach the gather writes, so a probe above standing elsewhere lends the light of what this ray would meet.
When the whole suite is lost, the test script counts the tests it printed as ending, runs again only the parts holding a test without a result, and says the lost process's slowest tests with their times.
The README's head is one centered block of Markdown and its gallery Markdown tables of the captures made small, which build/examples-table.py writes into .github/assets/gallery, so nuget.org draws the heading, the badges and the pictures.
Each tile's screen probe sends its sixteen rays from one of sixteen places in their texels, every four tiles by four holding each place once, so the probes read the hemisphere evenly and the window's filter blends the places together.
The soak bounds Manor's entities by the most a whole walk holds at once, as its other figures are, and a figure that climbs is said with where the walk stood at each half's least.
A program may say of a model shader that its vertex stage keeps its mesh's positions, so a mesh drawn with it is left out of each pass that cannot see the mesh's box, as one drawn with the model pass's own shader is.
A world probe more than a quarter of whose rays meet faces from behind is walled in and holds nothing, so a probe the trace moved into stone beside a lamp lends the ground outside the wall none of the lamp's light.
The test of a scene file written again holds its third copy against the mesh the first had before the write, since the step that next asks for the files' times spawns the earlier copies again too and may be the step after the write.
The screen's march passes a face it meets from behind as it passes behind the depth, so a probe's ray past a thin wall's end reads the face it meets rather than the lit face the eye sees beyond it.
A commit whose every file lies under .github is left out of a package's release notes, since the package carries nothing from there.
A package's release notes are the commits since the newest package of its minor on nuget.org was built, read from that version's nuspec, so each package's page says what changed since the one before it.
The glow lights' pass takes a texel's light of the frame before only from texels whose surface faces as the texel's does, so a floor meeting a wall carries no line of light along the corner.
A section of a game's world meshed again when a block breaks is not stamped into the field as boxes while a cascade not yet built holds the section it replaced, so a room's indirect light holds through the frames after the break.
A probe's ray that passes through a thin emissive strip right before it meets the wall behind gives that wall none of the strip's light, as a path-traced reference leaves it out, so the probes beside such a strip read near the reference at the first bounce.
The march that tells how much of a glow light a surface sees takes its cone as wide as the light's box across the way toward each surface it passes, so a thin emissive strip lights the ceiling and floor beside the wall it is mounted on as its closed form does.
title: 3DEngine
